title: R1: drop truncated/looping DeepSeek generations
description: deepseek.py:135 ignores finish_reason; workflow_gen.generate_one never checks for apply/diff. Kept traces include mid-form cutoffs and repetition loops. Fix: surface finish_reason, drop 'length', add repetition detector. (Jackrong distill notebook records finish_reason for this reason.)

title: R1: strict diff validation + validator must filter
description: No diff is ever validated: 659/891 workflow diffs have wrong @@ counts, are truncated (record 1819 ends at '@@ -1,0 +'), 19 have no diff, 129 lack ';; apply:'. validator.py:135 has_old='-' in diff is always true; score floor ~0.35 passes anything; assemble_codeflow_dataset.py:150 only prints so 69 invalid records ship. Fix: recompute hunk headers from bodies (or rebuild diff via git diff --no-index), run git apply --check, require '^;; apply:$' followed by 'diff --git', and drop invalid records in assembly.

title: R1: miner strips trailing context -> corrupt transition patches
description: miner.py:251/282 call result.stdout.strip(), removing trailing blank context lines from the last hunk so hunk counts mismatch. All 87 corrupt transitions in data come from this. Fix: keep stdout verbatim (normalize final newline only).

title: R1: verify.py drops narrative lines and misaligns results
description: verify.py:115-118 treats every ';;' line after ';; result:' as result continuation and ground_solution drops them, deleting '--- Step N' headers and diagnosis prose (669/865 train workflow records). verify.py:179/206 pairs all blocks with results while forms filters empty blocks, so raw multi-line code after ';; eval:' shifts results by one and leaves the last fabricated result. Extra ';; result:' lines per eval are never grounded (31 train records). Fix: replace only the single result line; parse raw code up to next ';; result:'; absorb or reject duplicate result lines; reject traces with unparseable blocks. Repros in session scratchpad t1.py.

title: Data pipeline + training config audit fixes (pre-training blocker)
description: Audit 2026-10-08 (three-agent review + Jackrong finetuning guide + Unsloth Qwen3.8 train docs) found the assembled training set is not trainable: 659/891 workflow diffs and 87/971 transition diffs fail git apply, verify.py deletes the error->fix narrative from 669/865 workflow traces, transitions edit files absent from the input, validator rejects nothing. Fix in TDD rounds, then regenerate and reassemble before Phase 4 training (qp8).
acceptance_criteria: All children closed; regenerated dataset has 0 git-apply failures, 0 records over cutoff_len in tokens, repo-grouped split; smoke training run decodes a sample correctly.

title: Retarget training to Qwen3.8-27B
description: Qwen3.8-27B (2026-08-14) is the same qwen3_5 arch/tokenizer as 3.6-27B, but its chat template adds a reasoning-effort line to the system prompt (default xhigh), defaults preserve_thinking=true (all past <think> rendered), and no longer parses <think> out of content. LLaMA-Factory has template qwen3_8 on main only (PR #10749, not in 0.9.5; main pins transformers<=5.8.0). Update configs, CLI tokenizer defaults, sharegpt rendering; prove parity with test_training_parity on LF main; re-measure lengths (preserve_thinking makes traces longer). Also pin DEEPSEEK_MODEL default to deepseek-flash (deepseek-chat now aliases it).

title: R4: add reasoning traces (<think>) to training data
description: Decision: keep thinking mode. Unsloth Qwen3.8 docs: keep >=75% reasoning data to preserve reasoning. Current data has 0 <think> tags. Generate per-turn reasoning (e.g. deepseek-reasoner reasoning_content, or backfill reasoning for mined transitions explaining why the change) and render assistant turns as <think>reasoning</think>\n answer (Jackrong normalize_assistant_to_think_solution). Validate every assistant turn has closed think block; filter by token length after template. Interacts with 0sv.12 multi-turn format.
design:
Decided 2026-10-12. Workflow reasoning comes from the live loop (per-step thinking). Mined transitions get a backfilled rationale: LLM sees request, before-state, real diff; writes the reasoning a developer would have before making the change, must not reference the diff; output becomes '<think>
rationale
</think>

<diff>'. Resumable CLI step over mined JSONL.
close_reason: clj-lora-add-reasoning backfills <think> rationales for transitions (smoke: 6/6 usable); live traces carry per-step reasoning; validator requires reasoning on every assistant turn.

title: R5: regenerate + reassemble dataset, smoke train
description: After R1-R4: re-mine, regenerate synthetic (DeepSeek cost), reassemble, verify 0 git-apply failures and 0 over-length; 50-200 step smoke run, decode a training sample to confirm template/masking, check loss drops (Jackrong §9.2).
notes: Pipeline order: clj-lora-mine -> clj-lora-add-reasoning (mined -> data/assemble/git) -> clj-lora-generate-workflows (live, needs jolt; smoke 10/12 kept) -> clj-lora-assemble -> clj-lora-split (sharegpt). One-shot synthetic sets (workflow_v1/v2) are dropped at assembly; regenerate. Before launch: tests/unit/test_training_parity.py with llamafactory installed (checks LLaMA-Factory's rendering equals Qwen's chat template and the loss mask).

title: R4: training config corrections (Qwen3.6/3.8 arch)
description: From Jackrong guide + unsloth.ai/docs/models/qwen3.8/train: (1) model is VL (Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration, model.visual.*, mtp.*): ensure LoRA hits language layers only (guide targets q/k/v/o/gate/up/down + linear_attn out_proj). (2) transformers v5 required (guide ran 5.9.0); config says >=4.57.1. Add flash-linear-attention + causal_conv1d. Drop trust_remote_code. (3) Thinking mode: data has 0 <think> tags; decide enable_thinking explicitly (empty <think></think> in response vs prompt) and use same at inference; Unsloth warns keep >=75% reasoning data to preserve reasoning — decide whether to add reasoning or accept non-thinking mode. (4) neat_packing: GatedDeltaNet state may leak across packed examples unless cu_seqlens supported — disable (guide never packs). (5) Step math: ~335-step estimate ignores packing; recompute warmup/eval_steps/patience. (6) Confirm qwen3_6 template string and decode a tokenized sample before launch. (7) Consider base Qwen3.8-27B (newer, same qwen3_5 arch, 262K ctx) and Unsloth path: QLoRA 24GB / LoRA >36GB, offload_embedding=True — cheaper than 80GB bf16. Same chat template + EOS at deployment.
notes: Decision 2026-10-08: training on RunPod, VRAM not a constraint (stay bf16 LoRA, no QLoRA needed). Thinking mode ON: add reasoning traces (see 0sv.19) so the model keeps reasoning; train with <think>...</think> in assistant turns.
close_reason: Config corrected and pinned by tests. Open decision for the user: Qwen3.8-27B (LLaMA-Factory qwen3_8 template, preserve_thinking) vs Qwen3.6-27B.

title: R4: token-based length filter + repo-grouped split + balancing
description: assembler.py:105 filters 50K chars assuming 3.5 c/tok; number-heavy results ~1.1 c/tok; 3 train records >16384 tokens get cut mid-diff; system prompt excluded. Filter with the target tokenizer after applying the chat template (Jackrong filter_long_sequences_batched). splitter.py:40 splits per record: 18 val inputs identical to train, near-dup instructions across workflow/transition — carry repo_name/commit and group-split by repo. assembler.py:64 change-type classification uses substrings over code ('fix' in 'prefix'); default max_per_type=None caps all buckets to the smallest — classify on instruction with word boundaries, sane default.

title: R4: multi-turn format with masked REPL observations
description: Single-turn outputs include ';; result:' lines in the loss, teaching the model to fabricate REPL output instead of waiting for nREPL. Convert to multi-turn (sharegpt/messages): assistant emits eval form(s), tool/observation turn carries real result (masked), final assistant turn emits ';; apply:' diff. Also need inference agent loop that parses this (ties to a4j). Decide format with user before regenerating.
design:
Decided 2026-10-12. Records are LLaMA-Factory sharegpt with a tools column. Workflow: human request -> function_call turns ('<think>
reasoning
</think>

' + {"name":"eval","arguments":{"code":...}}) alternating with observation turns (real nREPL output, masked) -> final gpt turn '<think>..</think>

;; apply:
<diff>'. Generated by a live loop: generator proposes one step as JSON {thinking, action eval|apply, code|diff}; jolt runs it in one persistent session; real result fed back; first step's thinking lays out goal/files/plan. Single eval tool. Observation rendering is shared code so the inference agent (a4j) emits the same text. Transitions become human+gpt sharegpt records.
close_reason: Multi-turn sharegpt with eval tool calls, live generation loop, masked observations; training text verified byte-identical to Qwen's chat template under LLaMA-Factory 0.9.5 and main.

title: R3: LLM provider error handling + fallback fabrication
description: provider.py:267/deepseek.py:116: 5xx, ConnectionError, empty content not retried; one 503 aborts prompt mining (backtranslate_prompt catches only ValueError); generate_workflow 'except Exception: return ""' makes a 401/402 run exit 0 with 0 kept. gen_code.py:171 substitutes hardcoded _fallback_code trace with fabricated results on any exception — drop instead. Counters not thread-safe. Fix: retry 5xx/conn/empty, fail fast on auth/billing, per-item error handling.

title: R3: make bb eval output match real nREPL
description: bb_eval.py:72 pr-str runs outside *out* binding (lazy side effects corrupt value), no *print-length* (range hangs); one 30s timeout marks all forms failed and discards partial stdout; load-string resets *ns* so (ns ..) doesn't persist; 501 train results contain sci.impl.fns / sci.lang.Namespace objects a JVM nREPL never prints; errors render as 'ERROR: nil' with no class (match nREPL 'Execution error (X) ...'); missing value line counted ok; (System/exit 0) passes. Grading only checks last form didn't throw — require correct end state per bead 016. Fix prompts that say 'fresh babashka session' per eval and specify multi-line form syntax.
notes: nrepl#11 merged, v0.3.0 tagged (d779043) and pinned in jolt_eval.py. test_unresolved_symbol_is_an_error stays a runtime xfail until a jolt release with jolt#1323; it passes on its own then.

title: R3: sandbox babashka execution
description: bb_eval.py:157 runs generated code with full host env (incl DEEPSEEK_API_KEY), FS, network; 66 traces touch getenv/shell/spit; a getenv form would write the key into training data. Fix: minimal env, start_new_session + killpg on timeout, container/no-network if feasible.
close_reason: Jolt nREPL server per trace: minimal env, temp workdir, sandbox-exec (no outbound net, no $HOME reads, writes only in workdir); tests in test_jolt_eval.py

title: R2: renamed files show empty before-content
description: miner.py:446 reads base content with df.path (new name) which does not exist at base_ref; 64/65 renamed-with-edit files are empty in input. Fix: use df.old_path for renames.
close_reason: Fixed with tests; verified on cider-nrepl, sci, clj-kondo, clojurescript (331 arcs, all apply to base)

title: R2: mined output diffs include files not shown in input
description: miner.py:428/462 diff pathspec '*.clj'/'*.edn' pulls project.clj, deps.edn, resources/*.edn into the output while input only shows is_clojure_file subset: 35% of transitions edit unseen files (422 project.clj, 107 deps.edn). Also miner.py:420 diffs start^..end which includes filtered-out commits (version bumps, merged side branches) whose messages are not in the instruction. Fix: diff only the shown files; build arcs from consecutive selected first-parent commits.
close_reason: Fixed with tests; verified on cider-nrepl, sci, clj-kondo, clojurescript (331 arcs, all apply to base)

title: Stage 4: workflow-data generation script (mine prompts -> generate -> verify -> jsonl)
description: A runnable script that loads mined git records, backtranslates user prompts, generates plan-first iterative-REPL workflows with execution verification, and writes training JSONL. Exposes --git-data, --target, --min-pass-rate, --no-verify-execution.

title: Stage 2: workflow generation (goal/files/plan + iterative REPL with failures)
description: From a mined user prompt, generate the full agent trace: a plan pass (goal, files, ordered steps) then a workflow pass that builds one function at a time in the REPL, deliberately showing a failure-and-recovery arc, ending in a unified diff. Self-contained/executable. New training system prompt frames the agent's job. Output = the whole workflow; input = user prompt + one-line project context.

title: Stage 1: mine user-style prompts by backtranslating commit messages
description: From the mined git data, filter substantive commit messages and backtranslate each into a vague, goal-level user request plus a one-line project context (PlanSearch-style backtranslation). Produces the seed-prompt pool for workflow generation.

title: Redesign synthetic data to teach the full agent REPL workflow
description: Teach the LoRA the end-to-end workflow: general user prompt -> figure out goal -> lay out files -> sketch plan -> build iteratively in the REPL (with real failures and recovery) -> final diff. Grounded in RPG (plan-first, topological TDD per node) and PlanSearch (NL sketch dominates success). Input = vague user request (+ one-line project context), output = the whole workflow. Seed prompts backtranslated from commit messages. Failures are a feature: keep error->fix steps, verify the session reaches a correct end state.

title: bb_eval runs forms in repo cwd; file-writing forms pollute the project
description: The babashka eval harness runs the subprocess in the repo working directory, so generated forms that (spit ...)/write files create stray files in the project root and src/ (e.g. project.clj, src/core.clj, *.edn, *.txt). Run bb with cwd set to a temp directory so relative file writes are sandboxed and cleaned up. Existing stray artifacts from prior runs need manual removal.

title: Feature-tree evolution is a no-op: key mismatch drops all evolved nodes
description: evolve_breadth reads cat.get('category') but the LLM returns categories keyed 'name', so every evolved node is skipped (cat_id empty -> continue). Tree stays at baseline size (71->71 nodes), which caps synthetic task generation (only 173 tasks at target 300) and removes EpiCoder's key diversity lever. Check evolve_depth/evolve_detail for the same mismatch; make key extraction tolerant of name/category/id/label.

title: Stage B: ground synthetic solutions in real eval results
description: Parse a generated REPL solution (;; eval:/;; result: blocks + ;; apply: diff), extract the eval forms (multi-line aware), run them through the bb_eval harness, replace fabricated ;; result: lines with real output, and compute a pass_rate (fraction of forms that execute cleanly). Foundation for filtering in the pipeline.

title: Stage A: babashka eval harness (run forms, capture real results)
description: A module that evaluates a sequence of Clojure forms in a single babashka session (state persists via load-string), capturing each form's return value, stdout, and ok/error status. Timeout-protected subprocess. Foundation for grounding synthetic REPL traces in real execution.

title: Execution-verified synthetic generation via babashka
description: Both EpiCoder (2.3 iterative refinement) and IQuest (4.1/4.2 sandboxed execution) make execution-based verification the central quality lever. The synthetic pipeline currently fabricates ;; result: lines. Wire real babashka execution: run the generated eval forms, replace results with real output, and filter solutions whose forms error. Requires steering generation toward self-contained, runnable forms (no phantom project namespaces).

title: Trim git-mined before-state to changed regions (not whole files)
description: Triplet mining inlines the full before-state of every file touched across the arc, so 70% of examples exceed the 50k char filter (median 74k, max 3.1MB). For a LoRA at 8-32k context this is untrainable. Trim the rendered input to the changed top-level forms (the functions/hunks being edited) plus the ns form, using the diff hunk line ranges, instead of whole files. Keep the full before-state in MinedExample; trim only at to_dict().

title: Rework miner to IQuest-style code-flow triplets
description: Adopt the IQuest-Coder git-history recipe (Tech Report 3.1): (1) lifecycle windowing — sample commits from the 40-80% percentile of project life (mature/stable phase) instead of the most-recent N from HEAD; (2) multi-iteration (R_old, P, R_new) triplets via forward-search spans rather than single-commit before/after; (3) endpoint quality filtering (non-empty Clojure diff, meaningful combined message). Keeps the existing output schema; format change (drop fabricated REPL blocks) tracked separately.

title: DeepSeekProvider doubles /v1 in endpoint URL -> 404
description: deepseek.py built the endpoint as base_url + '/v1/chat/completions'. The synthetic pipeline's setup_llm passed base_url=https://api.deepseek.com/v1, producing .../v1/v1/chat/completions and a 404, so the synthetic generator could not call DeepSeek at all. Normalize base_url (strip trailing /v1) and fix the script default.

title: Assembler has no max-length filter; 1.2MB inputs reach training set
description: The codeflow assembly pipeline (load -> dedup -> balance -> format -> validate) never filters records by length. A full mine of the 22 repos yields inputs up to 1.2MB (~300K tokens) and 232/511 records over 30KB at --max-per-type 150. These blow past any training context window and get silently truncated, wasting the example. Add a max-length drop (or truncation) step in assemble_dataset, configurable via CLI (e.g. --max-input-chars). The validator already scores records but does not drop them.

title: 5b: Create tool-calling support — read_file, write_file, apply_diff, search_codebase tools

Assistant turns are trimmed in training, so the final ';; apply:' diff comes without its trailing newline: add one before git apply. Serve with Qwen's chat template and thinking on.
